description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Obstinate Gargoyle.
When Obstinate Gargoyle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Obstinate Gargoyle.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
